ash.settings.lsp.title: Language Servers
ash.settings.lsp.description: Configure language servers. View their logs and failures in Output.
ash.settings.lsp.note: Enable servers and set executable paths for the App Server profile. The workspace folder controls availability checks. Logs and startup failures are shown in Output.
ash.settings.lsp.changed: Installed packages changed. Refresh before saving.
ash.settings.lsp.available: {0} servers available. They start when a matching document needs them.
ash.settings.lsp.empty: No enabled server is available. Find a package in Marketplace or configure an executable.
ash.settings.lsp.saveFailed: Could not save language server configuration: {0}. Refresh before saving again.
ash.settings.lsp.missingLanguage: Open a code file or enter a language ID first.
ash.settings.lsp.helpText:
Language Servers
Use Tab and Shift+Tab to reach the workspace folder, language, Marketplace, server selection, enable switch, executable path, Save, Use Default, Refresh, and Help. Use arrow keys in server and folder lists. Configuration applies to the App Server profile; the folder only controls availability checks. Leave the executable path empty to use the installed package or PATH. Use Default removes the override. After a conflict or an installation change, Refresh before saving. Find opens Marketplace for the exact language and executable capability. Logs and startup failures are in Output; click a language server status entry to open its log.

ash.settings.categories.hooks.label: Hooks
ash.settings.categories.hooks.description: Configure automated actions around agent workflow events.
ash.settings.hooks.help:
Agent Hooks
Use Tab and Shift+Tab to reach the configuration scope, Edit TOML, Ask Ash, Refresh, and events. Use the Settings search to filter events and declarations. Press Enter or Space on an event or Hook to expand its details. Search filters event names, Hook IDs, commands, and paths. Edit TOML opens the selected configuration; save it, then choose Refresh. Ask Ash appends a configuration request to the current chat draft without sending it. Configured Hooks still require execution permission.
ash.settings.hooks.note: Choose a scope to edit its TOML or ask Ash to configure it. Hook declarations do not grant execution permission. Save the file, then refresh to check your changes.
ash.settings.hooks.search: Search events, Hooks, commands, or paths
